description: Send one SMS message via TopSMS (Czech SMS gateway). Costs credit: 160 chars without diacritics = 1 SMS, 70 with diacritics/emoji. Returns message id, number of segments and price in CZK.

from.description: Approved Sender ID (max 11 chars). Omit to use the default sender "TopSMS".

idempotencyKey.description: Optional Idempotency-Key (e.g. a UUID). Repeating a call with the same key never sends the SMS twice; the original response is returned.

send_at.description: Schedule for later: ISO 8601 with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00+02:00 (max 30 days ahead). Omit to send now. Scheduled sends return a jobId that can be cancelled with cancel_scheduled.

to.description: Phone number in international format, e.g. +420601234567 (Czech numbers without prefix are accepted).

name: send_sms
